statement: Make lagrange service init multi-partition-safe by default with shard-keyed partial emissions, accountId filtering, npm build/generate/deploy scripts, and Node >=22.12.0; surface quantitative data-locality execution telemetry in demo:account-summary; and clarify application-vs-harness framing and repository orientation across README.md, docs/README.md, docs/tutorials/first-hour.md, and examples/call-binding-account-summary/README.md.

constraints.statement: Update src/cli/service-wasm-scaffold.js so summarizeAmounts projects id, account_id, and amount_cents, filters by optional accountId in summarizeRun, emits shard-disjoint count:<shardKey> and total:<shardKey> partials, and reduces them into {accountId, contributingShards, totalCents, transactions}.

Add generate, build (generate + build), and deploy npm scripts and set engines.node to >=22.12.0 in the scaffolded package.json without breaking the single-stage refusal contracts of lagrange service build and deploy.

Export buildLocalityExecutionSummary from examples/call-binding-account-summary/run-call-binding-account-summary.js, include locality in the demo report, and log the row-to-partial transfer reduction in the phase trace while keeping stdout strictly JSON.
Spawn an independent subagent verifier to audit the diff and test evidence before landing, and record its approval with --verifier subagent:<id> --verdict approve.
